findings.title: DR-002 planted false positive mixes its forbidden claim with an adjacent reliability defect
findings.why_it_matters: The planted false positive includes a plausible divergence failure as well as the forbidden redundant-storage claim. A decision-model score therefore cannot cleanly measure whether the model rejects the forbidden claim; remove the divergence sentence, consistent with the eval guidance that adjacent true findings are not DR re-raises.
findings.first_evidence: .agents/skills/ai-review-report/scripts/eval/corpus/must-not-flag/DR-002-hybrid-storage/manifest.json:12 -- "why_it_matters": "Every log payload is persisted twice, doubling write latency and storage cost, and the two copies diverge when the second write fails after the first succeeded. Remove the object-store write or make one store the single source of truth."
